label: 038 post-hoc addition: N-of-M forecast votes (user idea: agreement across forecasts that predict a big enough move)
status: POST-HOC: added after the 038 verdicts were read; committed before any vote member or vote result exists. Same costs, folds, eligibility, one-position trade simulation, benchmark, bootstrap and decision rule as preregistration.json; only the SIGNAL differs.
signal: LONG at a scored candle when at least N of the M members forecast a log return > +0.003 (the 30 bp round trip at verdict_bps) at that horizon; all M members must have a finite forecast (otherwise no signal). Short side (descriptive): at least N forecast < -0.003.

vote_A.why: the idea as proposed: one 64-candle window, cutoff = number of sinusoids K = 1..5 (harm is K=3); nested members, expected to be highly correlated

vote_B.why: independent methods; lgb_L is stride 1, read at the stride-16 candles
vote_B.learned_member: lgb_L is seeded: a vote_B PASS also requires vote_B rebuilt with lgb_L_s2 to PASS (condition e)

vote_C.why: independent windows: damped Holt on 32 / 64 / 128 / 256 log closes

new_members.harm_k1: harmonic_forecaster n_harmonics=1, 64 window, no smoothing/detrending, stride 16
new_members.holt_w32: Holt(damped_trend=True, initialization_method='estimated') on 32 log closes, stride 16

members_scored_alone: the new members are also scored alone under the 038 rule (top-decile signal), labelled post-hoc
correlation_report: before reading vote P&L: pairwise Spearman correlation of members' forecasts per horizon on common rows (late half); reported, not decisive
